description: Prompts for preparing a structured mortgage broker meeting briefing pack.

cards.title: Broker Meeting Preparation Pack
cards.description: Walk into your broker conversation knowing exactly what to ask.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian property finance preparation assistant. I want to prepare for my mortgage broker meeting.

MY INCOME: $[X] gross annual; type [PAYG / self-employed / other]; co-borrower [yes $X / no]
LIABILITIES: HECS $[X]; card limits $[X]; [other loans]
DEPOSIT: $[X] available
PROPERTY: [suburb, state, type, $price, investment/OO]
LVR TARGET: [80% / 90%]
LOAN TYPE: [IO / P&I / unsure]

Please return:
1. Document checklist for the broker meeting
2. My financial summary (one page the broker can read)
3. 10 specific questions to ask my broker (3 about my profile, 2 about this property, 3 about loan structure, 2 about process)
4. Any flags from my profile to raise proactively
5. What to look for in a good broker conversation

DISCLAIMER: This is preparation and general information only — not credit advice. Seek advice from the holder of an Australian Credit Licence.
cards.best_for: Anyone preparing for their first (or next) mortgage broker conversation
cards.professional_review_note: This pack is the agenda for the conversation — not the outcome. A licensed mortgage broker gives the actual credit advice.

cards.title: Loan Structure Questions
cards.description: Prepare the right questions about loan structure before you speak to a broker.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian property finance educator. I want to prepare questions about loan structure before meeting my mortgage broker.

MY SITUATION: [investor / owner-occupier]; income $[X]; deposit $[X]; target property $[price]; [state]
CURRENT MARKET CONTEXT: [fixed rates / variable rates / unsure which to focus on]

Please help me understand and prepare questions about:
1. Fixed vs variable vs split — when each makes sense
2. Interest-only vs principal and interest — trade-offs for my situation
3. Offset account — how it works and what to look for
4. Redraw vs offset — the practical difference
5. 6 specific questions to ask my broker about structure

DISCLAIMER: General education only — not credit advice. Loan structure depends on your individual circumstances. Your broker will give the actual recommendation.
cards.best_for: Buyers who want to understand loan structure concepts before their broker meeting
cards.output_type: Loan structure education and question list
cards.professional_review_note: Loan structure decisions should be made with your licensed mortgage broker based on your specific circumstances.
